name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme with high-contrast interactive charts for Excava’s interface. This maximizes visibility and liveliness in low-light screencasts, aligning with Manus’ competitive edge. The trade-off is higher battery drain on mobile devices, but clarity and engagement in screencasts outweigh that cost.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes drain battery more, but Manus’ analysis shows users rarely screencast on mobile—most edits happen on desktop. A toggle for dark/light mode costs two hours of dev time and solves the real problem: some users hate dark themes. Ship the toggle, measure screencast engagement, and drop it if data shows no gain.
